name: @ci/fe-desktop
description: Local orchestrator desktop app (Tauri) for macOS/Windows/Linux — brings up CI-Server's own Docker Compose stack and shows it. Standalone project (NOT a yarn workspace) so the root Yarn PnP install stays intact; it has no dependency on anything else in the monorepo. Unlike frontend/apps/ios and frontend/apps/android (thin clients that wrap @ci/fe-web and point it at a remote appliance), this app manages its own local backend — see README.md.
